newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's CSN Jan-Sept net rises.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's CSN Jan-Sept net rises.

text.p: Brazilian steel producer Companhia Siderurgica Nacional said Thursday its net profit in the first nine months of 1996 rose to 184 million reais from 75 million reais in the same period last year.
CSN did not provide a net profit per share figure.
Profit adjusted for inflation rose to 133 million reais from 68 million reais.
Net revenue slipped to 1.65 billion reais, three percent down from revenue in the 1995 period but favorable considering a 13 percent decline in prices, CSN said.
The costs of products sold fell to 1.35 billion reais from 1.47 billion despite higher volume of sales.
